subject: PatchShield EDR + MDM renewal — pricing and SOW negotiation
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@patchshield.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: PatchShield Renewals <renewals@patchshield.io>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PatchShield renewal quote for Redwood Inference (EDR + MDM)

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — reaching out about the upcoming renewal for your PatchShield Endpoint Protection (EDR) and MobileGuard MDM subscriptions that expire 2026-06-15. Attached is the renewal quote reflecting our 2026 list rates and the consolidated discount we discussed last year.

Key summary (attached: PatchShield_Renewal_Quote_2026-04-28.pdf):
- EDR: 2,400 seats — $0.95/seat/mo (list $1.10)
- MDM: 1,200 devices — $0.55/device/mo (list $0.65)
- Consolidated bundle: 10% off the combined ARR
- Proposed term: 12 months

We also included standard SOC 2 Type II attestation and an ATO support addendum in the quote appendix. If you have any procurement or security questions, happy to jump on a quick call.

Best,
Jordan Ellis
Account Executive — PatchShield
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189

--- Attachment: PatchShield_Renewal_Quote_2026-04-28.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@patchshield.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PatchShield renewal quote for Redwood Inference (EDR + MDM)

Jordan — thanks for the quote. A few follow-ups from our side:

1) Can you break out the unit economics by seat/device and show the cost impact if we move to a 24-month term? We want to evaluate 1yr vs 2yr.
2) Security ask: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report (date-scoped) and the incident response runbook redacted for customer review. Also confirm where telemetry is stored and retention window for agent logs.
3) Commercial: PatchShield’s list increase vs last year is material — can you confirm any loyalty credit for long-term customers? We’re asking internally for a target of ~20% off list for the bundle if we commit to a 24-month renewal and consolidate all endpoint tooling to you (EDR + MDM + vuln scanner pilot).
4) Contract: we’ll need to review SOW redlines. Please send editable SOW and your standard Data Processing Addendum.

CC’ing Vivek and Monica for procurement and finance guidance, and Laura for security sign-off.

Thanks — can we aim for answers by Friday? Neha

---
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, IT Security Procurement
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | (650) 555-0146

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@patchshield.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: PatchShield Renewals <renewals@patchshield.io>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PatchShield renewal quote for Redwood Inference (EDR + MDM)

Neha — thanks for the detail. Quick responses inline below: 

> 1) 24-month pricing
We can propose a 24-month term with a 15% consolidated discount on the bundle (EDR + MDM). I ran this with Renewals and Sales Ops; I’ve attached a markup showing the 24-month math.

> 2) SOC 2 + telemetry retention
I attached our latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted customer version) and a telemetry FAQ. Agent telemetry is encrypted at rest in our EU/US cloud regions; retention by default is 90 days for raw agent logs and 365 days for aggregated telemetry. We can offer enterprise retention add-on if you need longer.

> 3) loyalty credit
We can do a one-time loyalty credit equal to 5% of the first-year ARR when signing a 24-month contract.

> 4) SOW & DPA
Attached: PatchShield_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf (editable PDF with comment boxes) and PatchShield_DPA_2026.docx. Please share your redlines; we can circulate a final SOW once agreed.

We’re available Thurs 14:00 PT if you want to discuss.

Regards,
Jordan

--- Attachments: PatchShield_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf (PDF, 86KB); PatchShield_SOC2_Redacted_2025.pdf (PDF, 320KB); PatchShield_Telemetry_FAQ.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PatchShield renewal quote for Redwood Inference (EDR + MDM)

Team — quick internal thread before we respond to PatchShield.

- Financial tolerance: We should aim for at least 18% off list on year-one ARR if they want a 24-month lock. The 15% they offered is close but combine with the 5% loyalty credit still short of our benchmark. Monica — can you confirm target ARR reduction in $ terms so I can present to finance?
- Security: Laura, SOC2 redacted looks ok, but telemetry retention is borderline. We should push for 180 days raw logs included in base or a capped add-on cost.
- Contract: Please add Procurement task to create PO template. Neha — if they provide an editable SOW, ask Legal for a quick redline pass for Warranties/Liability caps and data deletion obligations.

If PatchShield won’t move on price, we should run a parallel commercial conversation with EndpointSafe and start a vuln-scanner RFP.

Vivek
VP, IT Operations

---
On Thu, Apr 29, 2026 at 08:22 AM Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@patchshield.io> wrote:
> Neha — thanks for the detail. Quick responses inline below: 
> ...

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@patchshield.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, PatchShield Renewals <renewals@patchshield.io>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PatchShield renewal quote for Redwood Inference (EDR + MDM)

Jordan — thanks for the options and the docs. We’ve reviewed internally and can move forward if PatchShield agrees to the following final commercial and security terms: 

1) Pricing
- 24-month term with a 17.5% consolidated discount off combined list pricing for EDR + MDM (this folds in loyalty credit). Please reflect this in a revised SOW/quote.

2) Retention
- Include 180 days retention of raw agent logs at no additional cost; aggregated telemetry retention stays at 365 days.

3) Contract redlines
- We’ll send redlines for the SOW and DPA; PatchShield to accept standard Redwood deletion obligations and a mutual liability cap of 1.5x ARR. Legal will need the editable SOW to prepare final markup.

4) Procurement & signature
- Once SOW is updated we’ll raise a PO and sign via DocuSign. Please send an editable SOW and a DocuSign envelope. Target signature date: 2026-05-07.

Attached is a draft SOW with our high-level redlines for clarity (we will produce formal redline PDF once Legal reviews).

Neha
--- Attachment: PatchShield_SOW_v3_signed.pdf (PDF placeholder: final SOW to follow via DocuSign)
